minutes.headline: Planning Board denied the Slik Trust ANR with a fee waiver and sent a favorable White Tail Crossing layout report.
minutes.summary: The board denied an ANR at 545 Mass Ave for lack of Title 5 proof, waiving the fee on resubmission, and received a new Laurel Lane ANR. It voted a favorable layout report on White Tail Crossing, held the housing production plan until written Selectmen comments arrive, and worked through the Village Center District bylaw section by section. Members also asked for a workshop on the TC Passios dividing line.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board voted to deny the Slik Family Trust ANR at 545 Mass Ave and to waive the fee if it is resubmitted.
The board voted to send a favorable layout report on White Tail Crossing, conditioned on loam and seed in spring to address runoff.
A new Laurel Lane ANR was received and will be circulated to other boards, with signing planned for January 12 if feedback is favorable.
The housing production plan was held until the 12th, pending written comments from the Selectmen.
The board worked through the Village Center District bylaw and set revisions for the first January meeting, with postcards to parcels and public sessions to follow.

why_it_matters: The Village Center District bylaw would change what can be built and how buildings look in the village center, and owners of affected parcels are to be notified by postcard.
The White Tail Crossing layout report and the Laurel Lane ANR decide how land is divided and developed, and the runoff condition bears on nearby drainage.
watch_next: January 12: planned signing of the Laurel Lane ANR if other boards respond favorably.
First January meeting: revised Village Center District bylaw due, followed by postcards to parcels and public sessions.
